entry.title: Aljafería

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected exterior picture supports six round crenellated east towers, warm pale masonry and a raised scarp. Retained east/south map coordinates set approximate footprint, scale and entrance orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply the ground; the derivative retains palace geometry and bounded scarp, omits duplicated moat grass/outer terrain walls and slopes the access bridges toward coarse approach ground. Courtyard floors stay above sampled terrain. The original detailed source master remains reproducible. Anchor -0.897048689,41.656484624; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 206.4844743505745m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
